chart.candleFootprintTruncated: This view keeps the newest 400 candles.
chart.recordedEmpty: History for this coin starts when a sample is stored.
chart.tapeHint: Buy − sell is aggressive futures flow in each candle. CVD range 24h is 5-minute bars. 7d, 30d, and 90d fold stored minutes into 30-minute, 2-hour, and 4-hour bars and draw the running sum. CVD also resets at 00:00 UTC and at the current 4-hour open. Book shading is resting size for the candles on screen. A view longer than 30 minutes uses stored minute ladders. Color behind the candles is estimated liquidation intensity for the selected range. A combined cell is colored only when Binance, Bybit, and OKX each have their own price and open interest. Open levels stay until price trades through them. When stored minutes cover the candles, buy and sell sit inside each candle. Otherwise the right edge is buy versus sell at each price, and the bars beside it are estimated liquidation pockets. The lower strip is crowd long percent versus top traders for Binance and OKX. Open interest and funding are stored samples, one line for each of Binance, Bybit, and OKX. Liquidation bars are short notional minus long notional in that candle. The leverage mix is a model. The point of control and the 70% value area are aggressive-print prices for the candles on screen. Arrows mark a poke through a prior high or low. Squares mark a print size that repeats in the last 5 minutes. Informational only.
chart.postDelistBanner: Bars after {{date}} are {{source}} — {{exchange}} has no trades. Informational only, not financial advice.

openLevels.caption: Levels stay until a later candle trades through them. The line underneath is open long size minus open short size. The first sample places open interest already on the books. A level that closes because open interest fell was not liquidated. A traded-through level is not put back.
openLevels.withheld: Combined open levels are withheld until Binance, Bybit, and OKX each have price and open interest in this window.

line.liquidations: Last completed hour liquidations are {{current}}, {{band}} versus {{samples}} completed hours over {{span}} (percentile {{percentile}}).

unusual.noSample: {{metric}} has no stored sample to compare yet.

tape.netPositionHint: From open interest and taker buy/sell. Positive means that side grew.
tape.botCountsNote: These three counts are only the repeated clips above, not every market order.
tape.cvdMeasured: Futures CVD adds each aggressive print as price × size on Binance, Bybit, and OKX. The line fills in while this server is recording.
tape.incomplete: Window is incomplete — history is still filling.
tape.liqIncomplete: Liquidation totals only cover time this process has been watching this coin.
tape.unsupported: No perpetual tape for this venue. Showing Binance + Bybit when the same base is listed.
tape.none: No perpetual book for this symbol on Binance or Bybit.

orderBook.title: Order book
orderBook.subtitle: Spot bids and asks, grouped on the server. Walls are large resting size.

pastBook.title: Past order book
pastBook.hint: Each minute keeps the ladder. A wall that rested only a few seconds and then left is listed on that minute. Other size changes that the ladder missed — size that left, or a swing whose peak is gone — are listed too.
pastBook.none: No brief wall or size move in this minute.

orderDepth.title: Market depth
orderDepth.subtitle: Cumulative resting size by price. Green is bids left of mid, red is asks to the right. Same live book as the ladder.

liqHeatmap.title: Liquidation heatmap
liqHeatmap.subtitle: Estimated liquidation intensity by price and time. Binance, Bybit, and OKX each use their own price. Combined adds a column only when all three have open interest. Informational only — not financial advice.
liqHeatmap.subtitlePrints: Stored liquidation prints by price and time. Longs are positions closed by a sell. Shorts are positions closed by a buy. Combined adds a column only when Binance, Bybit, and OKX were all recorded. A quiet recorded column is a real zero. Informational only — not financial advice.
liqHeatmap.leverageMix: Leverage mix: {{mix}}. This is the model's assumed share of open interest, not a published book.
liqHeatmap.evenBlend: {{venues}} uses an even long/short split because no account ratio is stored for that venue.
liqHeatmap.missing: {{venues}} has no price and open interest in this window. Combined leaves those columns empty.
liqHeatmap.missingPrints: {{venues}} was not recorded in this window. Combined leaves those columns empty.
liqHeatmap.empty: No liquidation map for this pair yet.

review.title: Did the hot zones work?
review.subtitle: Hit rate and liquidation-increase use only signals with enough later price path and liquidation history for that venue. Missing data is counted separately and is not filled from the other exchange. Informational only — not financial advice.
review.signalsSubtitle: Newest first. Each row is one hot area. 1h / 4h / 12h show hit or miss, how long it took, and any price or liquidation gap.

orderHeatmap.title: Liquidity heatmap
orderHeatmap.subtitle: Resting limit-order depth. Green is bids, red is asks, brighter is more size. The wide right column is the current book; history fills to the left. Windows past 15 minutes use stored ladders, including size that only rested between minutes. Not executed volume.
orderHeatmap.empty: No live book for this pair.
orderHeatmap.emptyHistory: No stored book for this window yet. History fills while the desk is running, up to about 7 days.
